snippet.title: Off the Rails™
snippet.description:
Off the Rails™ lets you build and design a roller coaster while you’re riding it!  Create loops, corkscrews, jumps and more while earning more than 75 game objectives.  Save your coasters and ride them again with your choice of 14 different vehicles.

Coming soon to iOS and Android!
